Open Source Kubernetes

k8sdesk

A focused Kubernetes operations tool built to eliminate the risks of using a shared global kubectl configuration. Credentials stay encrypted on disk, commands go through a strict DSL, and destructive actions require explicit confirmation.

View on GitHub

Security first

🔒

Encrypted at rest

AES-256-GCM encryption. Master key held in the OS keychain, never in plaintext.

🚫

No kubectl needed

Embedded kube-rs client talks directly to the cluster API. System kubectl is never touched.

🛡️

Isolated config

$KUBECONFIG and ~/.kube are never read or written. Zero side effects.

Features

  • ✓ Manifest file manager — browse a per-cluster folder, edit YAML in a Monaco editor, apply directly to the cluster
  • ✓ Safe command DSL — cluster + namespace are auto-applied; forbidden tokens are rejected by the parser
  • ✓ Destructive-action guard — delete, apply, scale, rollout restart require confirmation
  • ✓ Production protection — prod clusters require typing the cluster name to confirm
  • ✓ Environment color coding — dev / staging / prod badges with visual distinction
  • ✓ Production red border — persistent red window border on production clusters
  • ✓ Theme support — GitHub Dark, Midnight, Solarized Dark, GitHub Light, One Light
  • ✓ Embedded client — no system kubectl required, built on kube-rs

Why k8sdesk?

The problem

Shared ~/.kube/config is a single point of failure. One wrong context switch and you're running commands against production.

The solution

k8sdesk isolates every cluster. Credentials are encrypted, contexts can't leak, and destructive operations have guardrails.
